properties.displayName: GO-PRD-SENTINEL-047 Microsoft Remote Desktop Service Remote Code Execution (Bluekeep)
properties.query:
let TriggeredIPs =
SecurityAlert
| where DisplayName contains "GO-PRD-SENTINEL-047 Microsoft Remote Desktop Service Remote Code Execution (Bluekeep)"
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(24h)
| extend A = parse_json(Entities)
| mvexpand A
| extend IP = tostring(A.Address)
| where isnotempty(IP)
| summarize make_list(IP);

let cefpa = CommonSecurityLog1
| where TimeGenerated > ago(10m)
| where DeviceVendor == "Palo Alto Networks"
| where Activity == "THREAT"
| where DeviceEventClassID == "vulnerability"  
| extend ThreatMessage = extract("cat=(.*?)\\(", 1, AdditionalExtensions) 
| extend threatid = extract("cat=(.*?)\\((.*?)\\)", 2, AdditionalExtensions)
| where threatid == "55815" or threatid ==  "56310" or threatid == "56313"
| where DeviceAction != "reset-both" and DeviceAction != "reset-server"
| extend IPCustomEntity = SourceIP
| extend URLCustomEntity = RequestURL;

let pasyslog = paloaltologs 
| where TimeGenerated > ago(10m)
| where SourceIP !in (TriggeredIPs)
| where SourceIP !in (vuln_scanner_IPs)
| where Activity == "THREAT"
| where ThreatType == "vulnerability"
| where ThreatID == "55815" or ThreatID ==  "56310" or ThreatID == "56313"
| where DeviceAction != "reset-both" and DeviceAction != "reset-server"
| extend IPCustomEntity = SourceIP
| extend URLCustomEntity = RequestURL;

cefpa | union pasyslog
